api.notes: Self-serve console with an API. The public instance-type catalogue (api.verda.com/v1/instance-types) lists every shape 1x/2x/4x/8x with instance-hour and spot prices; the marketing page only shows 1x, which is why the catalogue previously carried 10 one-GPU packages. Confidential-computing (' CC ') variants are a separate product and are not catalogued.

reliability.capacity_notes: Per-shape availability is a boolean (can a VM of this size start now), not a count. At the 2026-11-08 snapshot only H200 8x and RTX PRO 6000 2x/4x were orderable on demand; H100 8x, L40S 8x and the rest of the RTX PRO 6000 range were spot-only, and A100/B200/B300/GB300 were 'Notify me'.
reliability.notes: Finnish GPU cloud formerly DataCrunch; Finland/Iceland data centres; on-demand and spot instance prices. Burst option for non-regulated workloads: not MeitY-empanelled and data leaves India.
